# School of Journalism and Mass Communication at UW-Madison

> The School of Journalism and Mass Communication at UW-Madison offers comprehensive undergraduate and graduate programs in journalism, strategic communication, and mass communications research.

SJMC is a leading journalism school offering BA/BS degrees with concentrations in reporting, multimedia journalism, and strategic communication, alongside graduate MA and PhD programs focused on both professional practice and research. The school provides extensive student resources, research centers, and innovative labs for journalism education and media technology development.

## Undergraduate Programs

- [Undergraduate Overview](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/undergraduate/undergraduate-overview): Undergraduate major overview with degree concentrations and career paths
- [Reporting and Multimedia Journalism](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/undergraduate/reporting-multimedia-journalism): Reporting track for print, broadcast, digital news and multimedia careers
- [Strategic Communication](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/undergraduate/strategic-communication): Strategic communication concentration in advertising and public relations
- [Degree Requirements](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/undergraduate/degree-requirements): Degree requirements for BA and BS in journalism programs
- [Certificates](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/undergraduate/certificates): Certificate programs in digital analytics, sports communication and studies
- [Undergraduate Admissions](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/undergraduate/undergraduate-admissions): Admissions requirements, deadlines and application info for undergraduates
- [Undergraduate Academic Advising](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/undergraduate/undergraduate-academic-advising): Academic advising resources and support for undergraduate students

## Graduate Programs

- [Graduate Overview](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/graduate/graduate-overview): Graduate programs overview including PhD and MA programs
- [PhD in Mass Communications](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/graduate/phd-in-mass-communications): PhD program in mass communications with research focus
- [Professional MA](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/graduate/professional-ma): Professional MA program preparing journalists for newsroom careers
- [Research MA](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/graduate/research-ma): Research MA program with theoretical and analytical skills training
- [Graduate Admissions](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/admissions/graduate-admissions): Graduate admissions requirements and application process
- [Financial Aid](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/graduate/financial-aid): Graduate financial aid including assistantships and scholarships

## Research and Innovation

- [Research Centers and Groups](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/graduate/research-centers): Research centers including journalism ethics and civic renewal
- [Mass Communication Research Center](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/mcrc): Mass Communication Research Center with social media and civic research
- [Public Tech Media Lab](https://ptml.sjmc.wisc.edu): Public Tech Media Lab for open-source journalism tools and AI systems

## Student Support and Resources

- [Climate and Wellness Resources](https://sjmc.wisc.edu/climate-and-wellness-resources): Student wellness, mental health and campus support resources
